notes: The chapter analysed one construction two ways. At DEU.22.7 a single written lema'an takes both of the ASV's 'that's as its discontinuous unit and its waw keeps only 'and'; here the second 'if' was folded into the waw as a rule 55 coordinator-and-subordinator pair. Rule 55's closing paragraph excludes exactly this verse by name — a subordinator whose scope reaches the coordinated clause takes its own rewritten occurrence, and the waw keeps only the coordinator written for it — and the chapter's recorded convention says the same. 'im (s002) now holds both 'if's, headed on the first; the waw (s009) holds only 'or'.
